primary_entry.label: Start the beginner guide
primary_entry.observed: The largest homepage button is the orange primary action and leads to the internal beginner guide; the official Roblox game is a smaller footer link.

navigation_result: The shared header and footer expose all 8 indexable routes, while page-specific calls to action create natural paths among beginner, codes, tanks, stats, badges, gems, and FAQ content.

fact_review.notes: Published identity, gameplay, progression, badge, stat, gem, and code claims stay within approved fact IDs. Mutable claims carry the August 20, 2026 check date, and disputed exact tank trees are not presented as fact.

codes_review.notes: Only these four official-page codes appear as prominent chips or copy cards; long third-party lists are explicitly rejected.

asset_review.notes: The UI uses project-authored CSS shapes and the Kimi package's project-authored og.png. It has no external font, script, image, or unclear-license dependency.
